title: Fix fuzz CMake include dir for schnorr48 (lichen_log.h not found)
description: lichen/tests/fuzz/CMakeLists.txt: fuzz_schnorr48 target fails to build because schnorr48.c includes <lichen/lichen_log.h> (since commit edddb5117d) but the target lacks the lichen/include dir. fuzz_frame builds fine. Pre-existing; discovered during project-LICHEN-2auf.35.2 verification.
close_reason: Fixed in lichen/tests/fuzz/CMakeLists.txt: added LICHEN_INCLUDE_DIR (../../include) to fuzz_schnorr48 target_include_directories so <lichen/lichen_log.h> resolves. Also added the missing FUZZ_STANDALONE define block for fuzz_schnorr48 (frame/schc already had it) and a FUZZ_STANDALONE main() driver in fuzz_schnorr48.c mirroring fuzz_frame.c — without it the target links nowhere on AppleClang (no libFuzzer). Host verification: cmake configure + 'cmake --build build --target fuzz_schnorr48' -> [100%] Built target fuzz_schnorr48; ran ./build/fuzz_schnorr48 100000 42 -> '100000 iterations completed, no crashes'. Note: workstation Linux clang + libFuzzer mode still fails later at schnorr48.h [[nodiscard]] under default gnu17 — pre-existing, filed project-LICHEN-worker6-74dc.
